$comment: Expectations drafted with `pnpm packs:truth` (each repository's own TypeScript, target linked; and the old side of its own upgrade commit) and reviewed by hand on 2026-10-14, before the pack was scored. Pure insertions (the dataCollection blocks each repository added to keep v10's restrictive collection) are the data-collection decision, not sites; a line changed only to gain a trailing comma for such an insertion is part of it. Supporting import edits and file moves made in the same commit are not Sentry sites. See ../sentry/RESEARCH.md. silent (UPT-123): each Sentry.init that left dataCollection unset with sendDefaultPii unset or false, read from its upgrade's diff on 2026-10-19 after the record was written: required where the upgrade set a restrictive dataCollection there to keep v10's collection (moved files and imported constants included), product-choice where it upgraded the init and accepted v11's defaults.

repos.why: App with a CommonJS next.config.js: no compiler diagnostic at the target (the config is not in the TypeScript program), both sites are config-only. Merge 1bb5bbb6d50c04252a6417ae2a04911f0dd7989f; its second commit moves sentry.*.config.ts into src/sentry (instrumentation.ts:5 and :9 change only for that move: not Sentry sites).

findings.note: disableLogger: true moves to webpack.treeshake.removeDebugLogging; the comment line above it is not a site.

repos.why: App with next.config.ts (TS2305 at the import) and a server config that relied on ignoreTransactions, a no-op under span streaming that the compiler does not flag in an object literal. Upgrade 4bc04eeb3702508172724b0d71e68b47d008a64f. instrumentation-client.ts:8 and sentry.edge.config.ts:6 change only to add a comma before the inserted dataCollection block.

findings.note: TS2305 Module '"@sentry/nextjs"' has no exported member 'withSentryConfig'.
ignoreTransactions becomes ignoreSpans with the same pattern.

repos.why: App with three Sentry.init calls passing sendDefaultPii: false (TS2353 each) and next.config.ts (TS2305). Upgrade 64d4a872621c449c054275c351e7653579b29ec3 replaces each with a restrictive dataCollection; the import edits on line 2 of each config only bring that helper in.
